name: Taiyo Solar Works
description: A block theme for a regional solar installation company: a neutral grey ground, graphite and one small sun-ochre accent, Merriweather over Source Sans 3. The home page opens on a half-and-half split with a roof photograph beside a graphite gradient panel and an inset portrait, then shows a featured installation with two overlapping hairline circles, white numeral cards for recent installations, a ruled price list, a graphite roof-assessment band under a shallow roof-pitch edge, named installers and the journal as thin news lines. Sample content in English; inner pages and other languages follow. Works without any plugin.

fonts.role: display: headings, figures and the company name
text: body, labels, the menu and buttons

summary.en: A solar installer theme: split first screen with an inset portrait, overlapping case circles and white numeral cards.
